question: Where can I get a list of wind farms in operation in Spain, with location, capacity (MW), number of turbines, operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: No tested national public source supplies every requested field for all operating farms. Choose a regional member by territory: Galicia lists owners and years; Valencia maps turbines. Iberdrola identifies operator and details for selected farms. AEE covers 17 communities but some operating labels are stale.
main_caveats: AEE marks Es Milá operational although dismantling was completed in 2026 after operations ceased in 2023.
A promoter, registered holder or owner is not necessarily the current operator.
In Castilla y León, 229 of 305 AEE records share a coordinate with another record; do not assume exact farm locations.
Valencia maps turbines with multiple permit statuses; do not sum the repeated farm MW or confuse an exploitation permit with live generation.
Aragón geometry is projected but its downloaded CSV/GeoJSON do not declare a CRS; confirm metadata before transforming.
answer.confidence_reason: Official records and 17 AEE objects checked; territory completeness, current operations, Aragón CRS and current export remain unresolved.

how_to_use.example_result: Castilla y León member, CABEZA MESA, AVILA, potencia_total_kw 29600, no_aerogene_radores 15, pot_unit_kw 1800, fecha_puesta_en_marcha 2011-06-21. The reported total differs from the sum of the turbine ratings.
steps: Castilla y León: paginate the API records using limit and offset.
Divide potencia_total_kw by 1000 for MW and review multiple rows for one park.
Navarra: read ENERGI_Lin_Peolico.dbf and .shp in the ZIP; PUESTSERV is the year, NUMAEROS the number of turbines and PROMOTOR the promoter.
Andalucía: read 10_02_ParqueEolico.shp and .dbf; decode DBF as UTF-8.
Catalunya: read the CSV and select ESTAT = En servei; rows are by municipality.
Aragón: read CSV fields parque, titular, potencia and polygon WKT; verify coordinate system from official metadata.
Galicia: the INEGA PDF table on page 1 gives name, net kW, owner, registration, year and municipality; divide kW by 1,000. Owner is not necessarily operator.

Comunitat Valenciana: use the named WFS GeoPackage member, filter estado_tramitacion = Autorización de explotación, then group cod_aerogenerador by nombre_parque_eolico and file identifier. Check duplicates and completeness; do not sum the repeated park MW field.

Valencia member tested request: https://terramapas.icv.gva.es/2601_Eolicas?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature&typeNames=ParquesEolicos.Aerogeneradores&outputFormat=gpkg . It returned 13 exploitation-authorised turbine records for Cofrentes, each with 49.79 MW park capacity.
reading_traps: The catalogue states parks with distinct machines or in two provinces may have multiple rows.
For CABEZA MESA the reported total (29,600 kW) differs from 15 × 1,800 kW; do not silently recalculate.
Navarra uses line geometries joining turbines; a line is not an individual turbine point. Promoter is not necessarily the operator.
Andalucía geometries are multipoints, and DBF has no turbine count.
Catalunya contains authorised and proposed plants too; applicant is not necessarily the operator and rows may repeat parks by municipality.
The 287-record API count refers only to Castilla y León; other member datasets have their own counts and formats.
Valencia WFS returns turbine points, not park polygons; exploitation permission does not guarantee current operation. Park power is repeated per turbine.
Aragón CSV and purported GeoJSON coordinates are projected and contain no CRS declaration. Do not read these metres as longitude and latitude.
Galicia PDF calls the party Propietario (owner), not operator. Multiple commissioning years can occur.
For Txutxu, the Navarra member reports 17.4 MW while the 2023 environmental study reports 15.1 MW; dates and source definitions differ and the discrepancy is unresolved.
